visual_logic.surface_detail: A 'ghost of the past' look—retaining primitive Early Jurassic traits in a Cretaceous body, mapped uniformly across its full horizontal lateral flank.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus remains on its small size and the 'relict' limb structures oriented parallel to the camera plane.
visual_logic.environment: Sun-lit sea with 'Ancestral Seagrass' meadows. The limestone ridges and plant life are shifted entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a sharp, measurable silhouette line.

pose: The small relict ichthyosaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original hidden peaking pose is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path. This stretches its snout, compact torso, primitive front and rear paddles, and tail fluke end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
